errors.description: The target renders 'DEFEAT' as mixed-case '战败', but the source is ALL-CAPS and the guidelines require ALL-CAPS to stay ALL-CAPS. In zh_Hans this should be rendered with full-width uppercase letters (e.g., ＤＥＦＥＡＴ) or an equivalent all-caps treatment; using normal casing inverts the intended battle-shout style.
The target says '双倍战斗速度' which means 'Double battle speed', whereas the source says 'X2 Battle speed'. The source uses 'X2' as a multiplier label, not the word 'double'.

The target reads 'girl with electricity' or 'electrified girl', whereas the source 'Electrifying girl' suggests a girl who is thrilling or who electrifies others, not merely charged. This loses the exciting nuance.

The target says 'Frost frost kitty', which repeats the element word twice and loses the pun/reference of 'Ice Ice Kitty' (a nod to 'Ice Ice Baby'). The repetition reads as awkward rather than as an intentional wordplay.
The target says '球形闪电', using '闪电' for Lightning, whereas the glossary requires '雷电' as the approved zh_Hans rendering for the Lightning element.
